The '''Fremennik Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas within the [[Fremennik Province]], such as [[Neitiznot]] and [[Jatizso]], [[Miscellania]] and [[Etceteria]], the [[God Wars Dungeon]], [[Lunar Isle]], and [[Waterbirth Island]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Thorodin]] just south of [[Rellekka]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.
